text: This solution, Consolidation and Mainstreaming of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) in China addresses natural catastrophe in China between Government of China, Integrated Research on Disaster Risk (IRDR), United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), and World Bank. The program was implemented in 1998 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
